unlocks.summary: Nothing left to unlock. Pendle's docs say all team and investor tokens were fully vested by September 2024. New supply now comes only from weekly incentive emissions, which aren't unlocks.

token.name: Pendle
token.description: Pendle is a protocol that enables the tokenization and trading of future yield. With the creation of a novel AMM that supports assets with time decay, Pendle gives users more control over future yield by providing optionality and opportunities for its utilization.
